name: luchragán
text: luchragán is a MacKillop variant spelling of leprechaun, listed with the alternate form luchramám. MacKillop records the form with a question mark as one of several dialect spellings of the same folkloric being. The full record of the leprechaun tradition in Celtic folklore sits under the headword leprechaun.

attributes.attribute: Variant spelling of leprechaun; pointer to leprechaun headword
